supported_guidance: Perform clinical evaluation including pulmonary examination and vital signs to assess for signs of lower respiratory tract infection.
Do not prescribe amoxicillin or other cross-reactive beta-lactams due to the documented history of drug rash.
Offer symptomatic management for upper respiratory symptoms (e.g., hydration, throat lozenges, saline nasal irrigation) pending clinical evaluation.
Instruct patient on red-flag symptoms requiring emergency evaluation, such as difficulty breathing, persistent high fevers, or chest pain.
